subject: Partner Center referral: ownership heuristics and intake fields
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@contoso.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: pc-support@microsoft.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso pilot)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile you showed looks promising for our customer-facing assistant. I was asked to start the formal referral intake in Partner Center so the Contoso field team can get aligned with your sales reps.

Quick asks: can you share a mapping of which Redwood seller should be associated with Contoso accounts during intake? Contoso operates multiple subsidiaries and we want to make sure referrals route to the right account owner. I've attached a CSV of the current Contoso account roster for reference.

Also: is there an acceptance workflow you prefer (seller consent vs. automatic owner assignment)? Our legal folks prefer explicit consent for any co-sell commitment.

Best,
James
James Porter
Corporate Accounts, Contoso
Attachment: contoso-account-roster.csv

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: James Porter <james.porter@contoso.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + Partner Center referral intake (Contoso pilot)

Hi James — nice to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the roster — that helps a lot.

High-level our intake options are:
- Manual seller consent: referral lands in Partner Center and the assigned Redwood seller receives a consent request; they must accept for co-sell to proceed.
- Auto-assign by matching rules: Partner Center maps the account to a seller based on territory/owner metadata; consent is optional and only required for commercial commitments.

Given Contoso's preference for explicit consent, I recommend starting with the Manual seller consent flow for the pilot. Operationally we can make the consent request include: Contoso account name, ARR band, and proposed engagement owner. If accepted, the referral becomes co-sell eligible.

I'll include Vanessa and Karthik to sketch the ownership heuristics we use (territory > last-touch > partner-intake-tag). Can you confirm whether Contoso's roster file includes the Microsoft tenant ID and primary field rep email? Those two fields make mapping much more deterministic.

Next steps:
1) We'll map your roster to our seller roster and send a consent batch via Partner Center.
2) Run one pilot referral (test case) and validate acceptance flow.
3) Iterate mapping rules before broad roll-out.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198
Attachment: pc-referral-intake-schema-v1.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:07:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Partner Center referral intake (Contoso pilot)

Monica — forwarding James' roster and Monica's notes. Summary + proposed ownership heuristic below.

Proposal (draft):
1) If Microsoft tenant ID present -> map to field rep by tenant-owner table (primary reliable key).
2) Else, match on top-level domain + country -> territory owner as fallback.
3) If multiple owners match -> last-touch owner wins unless ARR >= $250k then route to Enterprise seller queue for manual assignment.
4) For any account with partner-intake-tag: "co-sell-preferred", prioritize sales team consent route to avoid auto-assignment.

Operational considerations:
- Bulk consent: Partner Center supports batched consent emails but the template needs the "Engagement summary" fields filled out. Monica's schema covers those fields.
- Logging: we must capture Referral ID and consent timestamp for audit (SOC/compliance ask).
- Escalation: if seller doesn't respond in 7 days, auto-escalate to SDR manager for capture or re-route to shared pool.

Can Karthik comment on any restrictions from the partner center intake API (rate limits, field length)? Laura — please flag any GTM risks (quota, conflicting ownership).

-Vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Partner Center referral intake (Contoso pilot)

Thanks Vanessa — a few technical constraints from Partner Center/API side:
- Rate limits: intake endpoint allows 600 requests/minute per partner account; batch files recommended for large rosters.
- Primary key: microsoft_tenant_id (string up to 64 chars). If missing, the partner id + account_name composite is best-effort.
- Field limits: "notes" field truncated to 2,000 chars — keep the engagement summary concise.
- Consent flow: API supports createReferral + sendConsent calls; consent events return a referral_id and status payload. We can persist referral_id in our CRM via webhook.

Implementation plan (technical):
A) Normalize Contoso CSV to Redwood intake schema (Monica's xlsx).
B) If tenant_id exists do automated mapping; else run fuzzy match and flag for manual review.
C) Push batch via Partner Center batch import, then trigger consent requests for mapped sellers.

I'll prepare a small ETL script and a test batch for Contoso; expected turnaround ~3 business days.

-Karthik

From: James Porter <james.porter@contoso.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Partner Center referral intake (Contoso pilot)

Monica / Team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear plan. Contoso confirmed we can provide Microsoft tenant IDs for ~75% of the roster; the remainder will need the fuzzy/matching path.

We'd like to proceed with the manual seller consent option for the pilot scope (first 30 accounts). Please go ahead with the normalization and send over the test batch when ready. Also please include the proposed consent email template so our procurement/legal can review language.

If you need any additional fields from us (billing ownership vs. technical contact), let me know.

Best,
James
